svg.text: GMRS REPEATER REV 3 — EXACT SOLDER MAP
Use this as the build reference. It is generated from the corrected netlist, not a generative schematic.
Same colored label = same electrical node. Do not solder together labels that are different unless a component connects them.
RX_RED and CIRCUIT_GND / TX copper must NOT be directly connected. The audio transformer T1 is the isolation barrier.
1) RX SIDE: RADIO → C1 → VR1 → T1 PRIMARY
to VR1 outer lug B and T1 primary cold
to RX red only, not circuit ground
C1 = 10µF. Non-polar/bipolar preferred; if electrolytic, + usually toward RX_BLUE.
C2 = 1µF. If electrolytic, + goes toward LM2904P pin 3.
3) LM2904P DIP-8 SOCKET CONNECTIONS — TOP VIEW PIN NUMBERS
short to pin 2; also to C3 input and R8 to GPIO34
C2 output side + R3 100k to VREF
Only pin-to-pin shorts on U1: 1↔2 and 6↔7.
LM pin 8 to LM pin 4, close to chip
5) TX AUDIO: LM OUTPUT → VR2 → TX MIC
to TX radio 2.5mm TIP / green wire
C3 = 1µF, + toward LM pin 1. R1 = 4.7k start; 2.2k only if TX audio is too quiet.
from Q1 base to Q1 emitter
to TX radio 2.5mm RING / blue wire
GPIO22 HIGH keys TX by pulling TX_BLUE to TX copper/circuit ground. Check Q1 pinout before soldering.
LM pin 8, VREF R4 top, one side of C5/C6
1. RX_RED must NOT short to TX copper / CIRCUIT_GND.
2. LM pin 1 should short to pin 2. LM pin 6 should short to pin 7.
3. LM pin 4 should connect to TX copper/circuit ground. LM pin 8 should connect to +3.3V.
4. TX_BLUE should NOT be grounded until Q1 is driven by GPIO22.
Power-on voltage checks, before connecting radios:
• LM pin 1 ≈ 1.65V • Start VR2 almost all the way down for first transmit test.
• one outer lug → RX_VOL_IN from C1
• one outer lug → TX_LEVEL_IN from C3
• other outer lug → CIRCUIT_GND / TX copper
If turning a knob backwards lowers/raises the opposite way, swap the two OUTER lugs only.
• T1 one channel of 1:1 car audio ground-loop isolator transformer
• 3.5mm RX speaker cable and 2.5mm TX mic/PTT cable
